title: siRNA-mediated depletion of stable proteins in mouse oocytes
protocol: Collect follicles from 12-day-old B6D2F1 females.
Harvest ovaries into 300 μl of M2 medium.
Puncture the ovaries using a 30-gauge needle to release follicles.
Select follicles with proper size (100-125 μm).
Select oocytes with proper size (50-65 μm) within the selected follicles.
Ensure the oocyte is centrally positioned within the follicle.
Check that both the follicle and oocyte have a round shape.
Verify high density of granulosa cells around the oocyte.
Transfer selected follicles to IVG medium without PVP.
Incubate the transferred follicles for 1 hour.
Re-select follicles that meet all initial criteria after incubation.
Place approximately 15 follicles into a M2 droplet prepared in a microinjection chamber.
Prepare an injection capillary using the protocol for pronuclear injection with Puller settings: P=300, Heat=635, Pull=75, Vel=75, Del=80.
Fill the siRNA solution with FemtoTips.
Prepare a holding pipette with Puller settings: P=500, Heat=800, Pull=80, Vel=120, Del=100. Ensure the inner diameter is 50-55 μm to hold a follicle firmly.
Hold a follicle firmly and insert the injection capillary into the granulosa cell layers without penetrating the oocyte.
Release the siRNA solution within the granulosa cell layers using a single shot of FemtoJet.
Estimate the amount of siRNA solution released from the capillary by observing the movement of granulosa cells.
Adjust the injection pressure to ensure a constant amount of siRNA is injected into each oocyte.
Penetrate the capillary into the oocyte cytoplasm and inject siRNA.
Withdraw the injection capillary and whip it along the holding pipette several times to remove debris from the tip.
Flush the capillary with maximum pressure of FemtoJet after withdrawal from a follicle to keep it clean.
Repeat steps 6-3 to 6-5 for each oocyte.
Transfer injected follicles into medium ii and incubate for 1 hour.
Discard follicles with lysed oocytes.
Transfer the follicles into IVG medium with 2% PVP.
Prepare up to four 50 μl droplets in a 35 mm dish for culturing the follicles.
Do not place follicles close together during IVG to avoid aggregation.
Change half of the culture medium every other day.
Prepare IVG medium and preincubate it in a CO2 incubator overnight.
Harvest cumulus-oocyte complexes using a glass pipette after 12 days of culture.
Wash the harvested COCs 4-5 times.
Culture washed COCs in α-MEM for 15-18 hours.
Incubate sperm from caudal epididymides in HTF medium for capacitation for 1 hour.
Transfer MII-stage oocytes with surrounding cumulus cells into HTF medium.
Inseminate 1.0-1.5 μl of preincubated sperm (>3 x 10^4 sperm cells).
Transfer the fertilized oocytes into a 1:1 mixture droplet of HTF:KSOM.
Incubate for 30 min.
Transfer the fertilized oocytes into KSOM.
Incubate for five days.
